source.note: This catalog records metric names and hierarchy only. Student scores for charts must come from the first worksheet raw score table; do not convert these scores to a 0-100 percentage scale.

input_contract.provided_metrics: Each assessment may contain only a subset of these metrics. Missing metrics mean not assessed or not supplied; they must not be treated as low, normal, or absent abilities.
input_contract.chart_score_rule: Charts use raw scores from the first students_scores worksheet. If fixed P20/P80 norm boundaries are supplied, detailed indicator charts must render three color bands and an arrow for the raw score; do not print the numeric score in the chart.
input_contract.level_rule: Use level, percentile_band, and interpretation supplied by the scoring service as the source of truth. Do not turn a raw score into 优势区、常态区、潜力区 with a global threshold unless this scale version supplies an explicit threshold configuration.
input_contract.direction_rule: Do not infer whether a high score is positive or negative from a metric name. In particular, 负性情绪 and task-based indicators require an explicit direction or interpretation from the scoring service.
